title: Explicit-clock record replay observations v11
description: Software replay observations, not a hardware-failure acquisition schema. expected_s retains the source group-message clock used to schedule the replay. No missing scalar is replaced by zero or a negative health label.

expected_s.description: Unmodified group-message timestamp relative to the source record's first message; declared replay schedule only.

capture_s.description: Declared software timestamp including stale/withheld controls; not a calibrated sensor acquisition timestamp.

publish_s.description: Declared software publication observation including offset/delay/drop controls.
